## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* Support `genai-prices` 0.1.7 and new OpenAI audio models by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8617
* Add OpenAI `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6-luna` model support by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8635
* Add Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) support by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8637
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Preserve `UIMessage.id` across Vercel AI `load_messages` and `dump_messages` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8623
* Preserve AG-UI `Message.id` across `AGUIAdapter.load_messages` and `dump_messages` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8632
### 📦 Dependencies
* Bump `genai-prices` to 0.1.8 by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8648


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/compare/v2.47.0...v2.48.0
